_comment: Recorded discovery for the shipped catalog: every model in data/models.yaml is still offered, so a dry run using this fixture must propose no changes. claude/codex report `snapshot` because neither exposes an offline model list; `available` is taken relative to the catalog (no `releases`, no `retires`).

claude.note: model list comes from the ACP adapter's model selector

codex.note: ids come from the codex rollout config

kimi.note: probe only: CLI present, no list available
